info.title: SteadyCron CLI
info.description: Infrastructure-as-code CLI for SteadyCron — declare your scheduled HTTP jobs and heartbeat monitors in a YAML manifest and reconcile them with `steadycron sync`, or manage jobs imperatively. Authenticates with a SteadyCron API key.

options.description: http: request timeout in seconds

options.name: --retries
options.description: http: max retries

options.description: http: backoff between retries in seconds

options.name: --no-retry-on-timeout
options.description:
http: do not retry on timeout (retries
on timeout by default)

options.name: --retry-on-status
options.description:
http: HTTP status codes to retry on
(repeatable or comma-separated)
still in flight

options.name: --skip-if-running
options.description:
http: skip a fire if the previous run is
still in flight

options.name: --misfire
options.description:
http: do_nothing (default) or
fire_once_now

options.name: --grace
options.description:
heartbeat: grace period before a missed
ping alerts

options.name: --no-stuck-run-detection
options.description:
heartbeat: disable stuck-run detection
(enabled by default)

options.name: --max-run-duration
options.description:
heartbeat: max in-flight run duration
before a /start is abandoned
